blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Thursday said no public funds had been wasted following the withdrawal of three of the four articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte. The Senate impeachment court allowed the House prosecution panel to withdraw three articles, leaving allegations of unexplained wealth and failure to disclose assets as the remaining basis for the trial. Duterte spokesperson Atty. Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr., however, said the move had wasted millions of pesos in taxpayers’ money, adding that at least 20 days of trial proceedings could have been devoted to legislative work.
